title: Commercial Hotel, burned 1912, built by John Carr
description: The Commercial Hotel, located east of the railroad tracks, was partially burned in 1912. An article in the Observer from March 1, 1911, noted: “George G. McCollom, the energetic proprietor of the Commercial Hotel, has installed a new bathroom, one of the finest in Carleton County. In addition, Mr. McCollom had the office floor oiled, giving the place an up-to-date appearance. Commercial travellers who recently visited the hotel commented favourably on its improved look. They all joined in wishing Mr. McCollom success.”
